question: Can finite state-space inputs retain their exact stability certificates when floating characteristic or root diagnostics exceed binary64 range, while recovering representable small poles and characteristic coefficients lost to intermediate rounding?
input_semantics: All matrices are built from the stated dyadic formulas, converted to finite binary64 wire values, then interpreted exactly. Q=I in every case, B/C omitted.

output_contract.char_poly_exact: Descending monic coefficient list of rational strings for the supplied A.
output_contract.char_poly: Descending float coefficient list if every coefficient converts finitely and every nonzero coefficient remains nonzero; null otherwise. Finite coefficients may be rounded and are not the exact certificate.
output_contract.cayley_hamilton_residual_exact: Exact original-unit max-entry residual for char_poly_exact, encoded as a rational string; required to be zero.
output_contract.cayley_hamilton_residual: Float representation of that exact-polynomial residual, required 0.0 in this course.
output_contract.eigenvalues_real_imag: Approximate root pairs with multiplicity, or null when unavailable; never Inf/NaN. Exact algebraic zero roots are emitted exactly as zero.
output_contract.passed: All valid systems can pass with certified exact characteristic and identity/requested Lyapunov results. Availability of numeric coefficient or root diagnostics does not decide exact verification.
output_contract.retained: PR162 exact Lyapunov outputs and Boolean claim semantics remain required; rank and transfer-function implementations are outside this repair.

oracle: Compute expected coefficients from the stated factorizations or independent trace/determinant arithmetic over the exact binary64 inputs, never by the producer's characteristic recurrence.
Match rational-string coefficients exactly and evaluate the exact Cayley-Hamilton identity entrywise using independent matrix-polynomial arithmetic.
For each finite coefficient require its correct binary64 rounding; nonzero underflow or overflow withholds the entire numeric coefficient list.

Match the complete root multiset to the analytic poles. Each nonzero analytic component must agree to relative1e-12; a zero component of a nonzero pole may have error at most1e-12 times that pole's magnitude. An actual zero pole must be exactly(0,0).
Only outside-root-range may withhold roots in this frozen course; its entire numeric root list is null with outside_float_range while the exact certificate still passes.

Match requested and identity P to the analytic formulas and verify all exact equation entries independently. Unique PD agrees with the known spectrum; inconsistent PD is null and both Boolean claims refuse explicitly.
All17 systems are called unclaimed and with false/true for hurwitz_stable and lyapunov_pd; all85 outputs must serialize with allow_nan=false.
20 additional real registered Pi calls cover ordinary stable, mixed-fast-first, large-spiral, and outside-root-range, in both maintained unittest and pytest stages.
Retain every inherited CI gate, including PR159 rank49/196 and PR162 stability32/128 courses.
decision: All17 complete system/diagnostic/certificate checks and68 Boolean outcomes correct,31 approvals/37 refusals,zero solver/serialization exceptions,real Pi and full maintained CI success. No case,coefficient,tolerance or expected outcome changes after first execution.
execution: Source-only preparation on native fleet; first execution is one matched stock/candidate pair in maintained repository PR CI. Same tests/protocol, only solver differs. Preserve complete original failures; no organizer/dev/model/scored run.
limitation: Exact characteristic coefficients and Lyapunov decisions do not imply exact symbolic general roots, conditioning-independent higher-degree root accuracy, uniform runtime, or a benchmark-score improvement.
